description: 00:00 - 03:00: Continued milling 10 3/4" CH from 141,51mmd to 141,58mmd. 2000 LPM/15 bar, 80-120rpm/4-25knm, 3-6ton wob, ROP 2,3 cm/hr. Observed 170ltrs gain, MAX 3ppm h2s in fluid and a small gas peak at 141,54mmd, indicating that casing parted from CH. Experienced vibrations and string stalling out several times.
